name: 1social-youtube-shorts
description: A YouTube Shorts upload workflow for the 1Social connector: write the title and description, check that the video is vertical and short enough to become a Short, then publish now or schedule it.

interface.longDescription:
Upload a vertical video to YouTube Shorts without leaving the chat. Attach the clip, say what it is about, and get a short title people will tap and a description with the right links and tags. Before anything is uploaded, the video is checked: YouTube quietly turns a horizontal or over-long clip into a regular video instead of a Short, so those are stopped with a clear reason. Publish now or schedule it up to 30 days ahead in your own timezone.

After publishing you get a receipt that says whether the upload actually landed, with a link to it. Anything still scheduled can be edited or cancelled from the chat.

Requires the 1Social connector ("Instagram & TikTok by 1Social"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a6eeddc84a08191af3e632007e03ba3 and sign in. You also need a YouTube channel connected to your 1Social account.
defaultPrompt: Upload this vertical video to YouTube Shorts with a catchy title.
Write a title and description for this Short and schedule it for Saturday at noon.
Post this clip as a YouTube Short and to my other channels.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: guided YouTube Shorts uploads and scheduling over the 1Social connector.
